question: Explain how a meter bridge is based on the principle of a Wheatstone bridge.

options.A: The meter bridge is based on a potentiometer principle, in which voltage is proportional to the balancing length
options.B: The meter bridge is based on a series circuit, where the same current makes all resistance ratios equal
options.C: The meter bridge works by measuring the current through the galvanometer at its maximum deflection
options.D: The uniform bridge wire acts as two resistance arms proportional to lengths $l$ and $100-l$; at null deflection the Wheatstone condition gives $\frac{R}{X}=\frac{l}{100-l}$
